outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo summarizing amino acid frequencies across 120 proteins; it is not a plot of averaged replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
The dot plot shows mean ± SEM bars for inhibition zone (%) with individual gray dots representing each biological replicate overlaid.
Panel C consists of microscopy images, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Fluorescence intensity is plotted as mean ± SEM with individual yellow dots for each measured cell shown.
Fluorescence intensity (log scale) is shown as mean ± SEM with individual blue open-circle data points for each cell.
Panel F shows representative PALM super-resolution localization maps of individual cells, not an averaged summary plot.
Number of clusters per cell is shown as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell.
Cluster size distribution is shown as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots representing each cluster.
Proportion of molecules in clusters is shown as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell.
